scope: Matched ECAL-only B=0 electrons, total energy uniform 10–80 GeV; all events within each declared angular window, including zeros and tails, retained; no calibration
interpretation: Spectrum-averaged raw response width, including within-bin angular variation, losses and leakage; not fixed-energy intrinsic reconstructed resolution
bin_convention: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive; final upper edge included. Signed eta unchanged; phi coordinate/window recorded separately.

phi_coordinate.label: Si–W sector phase [% of sector width]
phi_coordinate.coordinate: 100 * signed folded phi / (pi/8); same coordinate for both models
phi_coordinate.note: Si-W reference phase, not LAr electrode symmetry; equivalent sectors pooled without reflection

bootstrap.resampling: shared whole-event multiplicities across models and projections; conditional on saved transports

input.geometry_scope: Complete LAr barrel/endcaps and local services; ECAL-only B=0; no tracker, solenoid, HCAL or FCAL
